candidate_relations.reason: The reference diagnosis is Malakoplakia. C001 specifies the same entity with the anatomic site (gastrointestinal tract), which is directly confirmed by the colonoscopic and histologic findings (rectal/sigmoid polyps with Michaelis-Gutmann body-containing histiocytes positive on von Kossa and PAS stains). The added anatomic detail is consistent with and supported by the clinical record, making it a complete equivalent rather than an over-specification that conflicts with the reference.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Malakoplakia of gastrointestinal tract vs. Malakoplakia — the anatomic qualifier (gastrointestinal tract) is fully supported by the clinical record (colonic/rectal involvement) and does not introduce an incompatible subtype; it is a harmless, record-consistent anatomic specification of the same diagnostic entity

case_quality_flags: Classic Michaelis-Gutmann bodies (basophilic spherical/targetoid inclusions, von Kossa+, PAS+) in an immunocompromised pediatric patient provide high diagnostic certainty for malakoplakia
